svg.title: Miguel García Bilbao, Senior Software Engineer, full stack and applied AI
svg.desc: A career drawn as a forecast plot. Observed trace from 2021 to November 2026: Softeca from October 2021 (full stack, then Technical Lead of a team of 5), nettrim from February 2026 with a RAG pipeline in production, and an MSc in Artificial Intelligence at UAX from March to November 2026. From now on, a forecast fan pointing at applied AI and senior frontend roles.
